verdict.rationale: The Sai REST API uses version-prefixed endpoints such as GET /v1/agents/events and /v1/agents/machines, so it is versioned. The docs also label a legacy desktop-automation surface as deprecated and kept for migration only, which shows deprecation happens in practice. There is no evidence of an actual deprecation policy, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy (notice periods, sunset timelines, versioning guarantees), a published OpenAPI/versioned API reference, a changelog of version changes, and independent corroboration.
